title: fix: make existing notifications open specific authorized destinations
body:
**Notification code and device follow-up are merged; current store delivery remains pending.** [Mobile #102](https://github.com/diegueins680/TDF-mobile/pull/102) merged normally as `0c1ee7f` after exact-head checks passed. Fresh notification, cold request and warm notification scenarios passed on both iOS and physical Samsung SM-S928B / Android 16. Merged `0c1ee7f` passed 83 suites / 492 tests and full release checks. The Samsung test used an isolated QA package to preserve the installed Play app; its unregistered Google OAuth identity is not a production authentication test. [Committed device evidence](https://github.com/diegueins680/TDF-mobile/blob/870020b/docs/notification-cold-start-2026-09-18.md).

Parent [#449](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/pull/449), normal merge `e1a825bda`, pins published mobile `90cae070`, proven to contain #102 plus later approved mobile corrections. Earlier pin PR #441 was closed as superseded; no further #441 approval is needed. Older production Android 14 / iOS 22 artifacts were not submitted. Store publication is now owned by the separate release task; this notification task has made no competing store, billing or backend changes.

**Refreshed verification, 2026-09-18:** the subsequent production API reports `ab9bbacc9da845b6bfe70ac3fda2ace44f17c918`. A fresh authenticated browser reload and both actual notification clicks passed again after that mail-service rollout. After reloading the authenticated production browser, the actual bell links again opened Galo Chiriboga at `/perfil/244` and request #10 at `/solicitudes-acceso?request=10`, displaying `Aprobada` and `Historial completo`. Both dropdowns closed; no review action was activated. Those notifications were already read, so this recheck does not claim a fresh unread-state mutation.

**Current mobile distribution, checked 18:38 UTC:** the release task has advanced the integrated release to Android 17 and iOS 25. Git ancestry checks independently confirm both sources contain notification merge `0c1ee7f`.

- **Android 15 is available to selected testers**, according to the release owner's authenticated Play Console readback at 18:20 UTC. Its independently verified SHA-256 is `628f0d835ac6632956df0a405356f84d000b38aaf67499511dbbb49446f9c530`. Newer Android 17, source `c2a4cb289dbc9bc52de98c6eac8a6ca81c0cfeae`, passed [GitHub build 35376997735](https://github.com/diegueins680/TDF-mobile/actions/runs/35376997735), was uploaded/validated/committed at 18:18 UTC, and is in review. Its Play digest matches the verified AAB `8ce174bd20d95ebf4c84cdbf505a3ce9aecf26b3ffed8bbb2bc8436c3a942b4f`. Public Play production is not released. The selected 68-person list was saved earlier; list membership is distinct from actual tester opt-in.
- **iOS 25 is processed (`VALID`) and in internal TestFlight testing (`IN_BETA_TESTING`)**, confirmed by this task's direct App Store Connect GET at 18:46 UTC. External beta status is `READY_FOR_BETA_SUBMISSION`. Source `9f4d0e89c430e25fcd572b4c87736cad15e12012` passed [GitHub build 35376470123](https://github.com/diegueins680/TDF-mobile/actions/runs/35376470123); signed IPA SHA-256 is `087137b510977a614541f0d80c01c76003def64afc687f2179780036b15de925`. The release owner validated/uploaded it, associated it with the version and submitted App Review. Review remains `WAITING_FOR_REVIEW`; public release remains `MANUAL`, not available. Physical iPhone Google OAuth is still unverified because no device is available.
- The newer integration [#454](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/pull/454) is approved and its remaining CI checks have passed at this checkpoint; it is owned by the separate release task. This task performed read-only verification and no competing upload, merge, release change or phone mutation. Earlier verified iOS 23 was superseded by the newer integrated build.


The implementation and original deployment evidence below are historical checkpoints, not claims that the fleet or store still runs those older versions.

## Result

Existing notification entry points now resolve stable, authorized resource identities. The reported new-fan notification opens the actual follower, and access-request notifications open the exact request with its current status and permitted controls. Navigation never approves, rejects, provisions access, or executes another business action.

The shared destination contract covers existing web bell/list links, logistics email context, native URLs and Expo notification responses. It preserves sign-in destinations, canonical directory identities, standard link behavior and accessible interaction. Individual read persistence is nonblocking and never optimistically confirms a failed write. Unknown or unrecoverable targets have explicit private fallbacks. The additive, journaled migration recovers historical targets only from unambiguous stored relationships and preserves history on rollback.

[Type/identity/destination/permission/fallback audit](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/blob/4b0bc6ed703089b25dc3480e2fb3acbb9277fac3/docs/notifications/navigation-2026-09-17.md). That audit records implementation-stage checkpoints; the final delivery evidence below supersedes its pending release status.

## Review and validation

- Independent approval of exact final head `a5a391954ec4152a19e1502c08347edd34624060`, all four review threads resolved, required CI run [35308680448](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/35308680448) passed. Normal merge `4b0bc6ed703089b25dc3480e2fb3acbb9277fac3` preserves immutable migration introduction `3cf19c64bd60610059af6c26ec40104093be21c5`.
- Final integrated backend: 2,579 examples, zero failures, one PostgreSQL-only pending example; hosted PostgreSQL/HTTP integration gates passed. Full local web run: 214 suites / 2,065 tests. Final native: 82 suites / 479 tests, release checks and hosted CI passed.
- Migration, rollback, ambiguity/history protection, payload/resolver, expired session, ownership, stale/legacy targets, read failure and action-boundary tests passed. Production-shaped 107-migration startup/replay and real directory context SQL regressions passed.
- Integrated preview browser suite: 20/20 passed across desktop/mobile/tablet and Chromium/Firefox/WebKit. Initial production-domain controlled-API run was 19/20: Firefox background-tab timing failed under host contention; bringing the destination tab to the foreground passed three consecutive retests. These synthetic API runs are distinct from the live production verification below.
- At the original rollout, iOS simulator scenarios passed and Android execution was blocked by emulator storage. The subsequent #102 follow-up resolved the discovered native runtime loop and passed all three scenarios on both iOS and a physical Samsung; see the current evidence above.

## Production delivery — 2026-09-18

- Authentication #422 and identity #426 were released separately before this notification rollout. Their final changes are integrated. No required gate or review was bypassed.
- Exact merged [Build Image run 35311217636](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/35311217636) passed. Guarded backend release completed at 06:18:14 UTC with zero rollbacks; both `ord` and `lax` Machines were verified healthy on `4b0bc6ed7` immediately after that rollout. Immutable image index: `sha256:15b0ba531287e6a43bb87d1afc09bdfce03084c39b6287fbe78491ec78863777`; amd64 image: `sha256:9113abd42ed3c434a4a64d55a3f305997a04650cac9c4fb3a4c8e89bbbd03fd0`.
- Fresh database snapshot `vs_ZzJkpJB0eqRsJM7V72JNNY` completed at 06:04:32 UTC. Read-only verification after rollout: 107 migration ledger entries, zero active release leases, one recovered notification matching its journal, zero remaining unambiguous legacy follower payloads. Runtime flags were preserved.
- Cloudflare deployed the notification merge successfully. Later web-only #429 (`c00578da5`) also deployed successfully and retains this fix.
- **Actual signed-in production browser:** activating the reported Galo notification opened `/perfil/244` and rendered “Galo Chiriboga”; activating the request notification opened `/solicitudes-acceso?request=10`, showing its current Approved status, feature details and history. Dropdown closed on navigation. Read-only hashes of all five referenced request records and 15 history rows matched before/after navigation: no business state changed.

## Historical initial mobile distribution — superseded artifacts

Mobile [#93](https://github.com/diegueins680/TDF-mobile/pull/93) and [#96](https://github.com/diegueins680/TDF-mobile/pull/96) are merged; final native source `2244490fffa9fa02b3a417efc336367141ad3dd0` is tree-identical to #96 merge `5faeeed88df2cf3efda06bde0cd7e9bc0b7cfc85`.

- iOS 1.0.1 build **20**, EAS build `880e552a-8cba-4e2d-be3e-c0780e693993`: [successful App Store Connect upload](https://expo.dev/accounts/cuco.saa/projects/tdf-mobile/submissions/5d388bda-e4d1-4988-887f-0c11472a157a). Apple processing, review approval and user availability are separate; this did not replace build 19's existing review.
- Android 1.0.1 versionCode **11**, EAS build `c5b04f86-5839-4137-a871-d5d3da1e6f8a`: [successful Google Play upload](https://expo.dev/accounts/cuco.saa/projects/tdf-mobile/submissions/5b3661b8-bb0f-4702-bdce-453009d82fb9) through the existing **internal/draft** profile. Authentication build 10's Alpha release remains separate. Draft upload is not reviewer approval or tester/store availability.
